# CanvasElement

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Invokes a caller-provided drawing function within the document layout.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IAltTextProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new CanvasElement(handler: CanvasDrawHandler, options?: CanvasElementOptions)
new CanvasElement(options: CanvasElementOptions & { handler: CanvasDrawHandler; })
```

## Properties

- [`altText`](#alttext): The alternate text for this element.
- [`drawHeight`](#drawheight): Height of the drawing box in points.
- [`drawWidth`](#drawwidth): Width of the drawing box in points.
- [`isDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true`, the author has explicitly opted into a decorative-only rendering: the element is tagged as `/Artifact` with no warning, even though no alt-text is provided.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

The alternate text for this element. Empty/undefined means "no alt-text"; the renderer treats such elements as `/Artifact` rather than `/Figure` when tagging is on, and may log a warning so authors don't silently produce inaccessible figures.

### `drawHeight`

```typescript
drawHeight: number
```

Height of the drawing box in points. Always explicit — a canvas cannot measure itself.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'8cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
element.drawHeight = 94;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/annual-report-geometric-cover`:

```typescript
art.drawHeight = PAGE.height;
```

### `drawWidth`

```typescript
drawWidth: number
```

Width of the drawing box in points. `0` (the default) fills the available content width; a positive value fixes the width and is clamped to the space available.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'8cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
element.drawWidth = 0;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
element.drawWidth = 84;
```

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

When `true`, the author has explicitly opted into a decorative-only rendering: the element is tagged as `/Artifact` with no warning, even though no alt-text is provided. Distinguishes "missing alt by mistake" from "no alt is correct".

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/annual-report-geometric-cover`:

```typescript
art.isDecorative = true;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
element.isDecorative = true;
```

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).
